checkpoint.crash_window: old manifest/generation remain valid if SIGKILL occurs before manifest replace
checkpoint.generation: content-addressed NPZ named by frame and state hash
checkpoint.h5_resume: truncate dynamic datasets to checkpoint frame and rewrite that frame
checkpoint.publish_order: fsynced generation rename, then atomic manifest replace

error_budget.path: RK4-vs-Euler per-step and cumulative estimates; no certified material bound
error_budget.real_source_hessian: not supplied; analytic upper bound unavailable

events.crossing: continuous linear segment crossings on usable RK segments

integration.field_access: all stages use current frame i only; no frame i+1 velocity/density
integration.field_hold_order: piecewise-constant O(dt) hold across native output intervals
integration.method: classical RK4 over each native interval
integration.rk4_scope: fourth-order integration of frozen current-frame field only; overall cross-frame temporal interpolation is not fourth-order

query_definition.identity: independent geometric seeds; no native particle_id or initial Mk termination
query_definition.mass: equal positive 1/512; all seeds remain denominator

resource_estimate.measured_full_canary: 724.82 wall s, 157536 KiB RSS for frames 0-90, 4 substeps
resource_estimate.measured_short_profile: 168.73 wall s, 158816 KiB RSS for frames 0-20, 4 substeps

unknown_policy.gate: no material reliability claim; numerical support mask reported separately
unknown_policy.rule: first failed numerical support stage makes seed permanent_unknown; later events/path updates stop
